transitions.guard: 发布权限；附件齐全；版本唯一
transitions.durable_effect: 固定内容摘要、适用范围和发布时间
transitions.recovery: 失败保留 draft；同操作重放返回原版

transitions.guard: 明确替代关系与适用时间
transitions.durable_effect: 旧版本保留、新版指针更新
transitions.recovery: 乱序通知按版本核对，不回退

transitions.guard: 针对原问题和确定设计版本
transitions.durable_effect: 保存答复及责任人，不变更价款
transitions.recovery: 补充问题另记修订

transitions.guard: 原因和原答复引用
transitions.durable_effect: 保留答复历史并开启待答事项
transitions.recovery: 通知失败从任务表补发

transitions.guard: 澄清足够且有关闭权限
transitions.durable_effect: 固定关闭理由，不生成应付款
transitions.recovery: 新技术问题新建或重开有审计

transitions.guard: 记录来源和受影响范围
transitions.durable_effect: 保存 ROM、单位与未定项
transitions.recovery: 资料不足留 assessing

transitions.guard: 每行已有获批/拒绝/另行处理决定
transitions.durable_effect: 链接后续 variation 与残留义务
transitions.recovery: 不得因一个行获批隐藏另一个未决项

transitions.guard: 有理由与责任人
transitions.durable_effect: 保留事件及驳回依据
transitions.recovery: 新证据新建修订，不删除历史

transitions.guard: 工作行、单价、单位和依据完整
transitions.durable_effect: 冻结待审版本
transitions.recovery: 版本冲突返回差异

transitions.guard: 权限、非自批、提交版本一致
transitions.durable_effect: 保存范围/价格快照、批准人、outbox
transitions.recovery: 同操作返回原决定；后续更改单独批准

transitions.guard: 提交版本一致且拒绝理由完整
transitions.durable_effect: 记录 rejected 与理由
transitions.recovery: 不得删除现场已发生的事实

transitions.guard: 身份、单位、证据齐全
transitions.durable_effect: 保存测量版本及现场时间
transitions.recovery: 断网保留本地草稿不称成功

transitions.guard: 累计量>=前序且<=批准量；版本一致
transitions.durable_effect: 保存有效累计和证书行
transitions.recovery: 写入后崩溃按业务键恢复

transitions.guard: 超量、缺证或单位错误已说明
transitions.durable_effect: 保存原实测与拒绝理由
transitions.recovery: 补证后新版本，不丢事实

transitions.guard: 已审核实测与有效批准；差额金额正确
transitions.durable_effect: 保存本期增量和累计依据
transitions.recovery: 重复证书 ID 比对摘要

transitions.guard: 有独立冲减/补充证书及权限
transitions.durable_effect: 原证书不变，关联调整记录
transitions.recovery: 不得改写已付金额造成假平账

transitions.guard: 证书有效；可用余额足够；固定身份
transitions.durable_effect: 保存请求与预留，再调用外部
transitions.recovery: 崩溃先核对 operation

transitions.trigger: 网络超时或结果无法判断
transitions.guard: 已有发送尝试
transitions.durable_effect: 保持资金预留与核对任务
transitions.recovery: 不更换 ID 盲目补发

transitions.guard: 外部结果身份金额收款方匹配
transitions.durable_effect: 预留转已付，保存回执
transitions.recovery: 重复结果无新增效果

transitions.guard: 外部原操作确认匹配
transitions.durable_effect: 预留转已付并完成核对
transitions.recovery: 回执晚到仍引用原操作

transitions.guard: 外部确认无付款效果
transitions.durable_effect: 释放预留，记录原因
transitions.recovery: 修正后需要明确新操作

transitions.guard: 可核验的外部失败或人工证据
transitions.durable_effect: 释放预留并保存依据
transitions.recovery: 仅超时不是失败证据

checks.when: UI submit -> certify -> request payment -> reconcile
checks.then: approved6000; certified3400; one confirmed payment3400; trace to RFI but no RFI payment authority
checks.evidence_required: UI state, submitted version, certificate lines, operation and external confirmation

checks.when: import same ID+hash twice, then same ID with changed hash
checks.then: one effect for exact duplicate; changed content explicit conflict
checks.evidence_required: unique identity outcome and retained conflicting payload

checks.given: rev-C is current, RFI refers to rev-B
checks.when: deliver rev-C then old rev-B publication notification
checks.then: current stays rev-C; historical RFI retains rev-B
checks.evidence_required: authority versions, effective time and UI version labels

checks.then: one immutable approved snapshot or explicit conflict, never duplicated amount

checks.given: two orgs use P1/RFI-1; subcontractor cannot see other bidder price
checks.when: read list, cache hit/miss, graph path and attachment
checks.then: no other-org or unauthorized intermediate-node data
checks.evidence_required: query scopes, graph node results and attachment authorization

checks.then: X remains unknown/reserved until reconcile; no new payment identity
checks.evidence_required: attempt ledger and original external operation lookup

checks.given: certificate committed, projection consumer not marked
checks.then: one certificate amount and eventual projected state
checks.evidence_required: commit record, restart log and final UI projection

checks.given: derived_from points output→evidence; reverse adjacency from design reaches A1 value1000 through two evidence paths; base5000
checks.when: traverse authorized reverse adjacency for downstream impact; traverse original adjacency for provenance; sum unique approved lines
checks.then: 6000, not7000; cycle yields diagnostic and terminates
checks.evidence_required: fixed adjacency fixture, visited IDs and arithmetic
fixed quantities, previous effective certificate and output

checks.then: reject certification, retain measurement draft and reason
checks.evidence_required: guard rejection plus unchanged certified balance

checks.given: RFI answered, variation rejected, 8m physically installed
checks.then: record physical fact as unauthorized; no signed certificate or payment

checks.given: first8m at50 certified; next7m effective rate60
checks.then: change total820, not900; old certificate unchanged
checks.evidence_required: rate-effective scope and immutable certificate hashes
